data.text: I’ll commit to 18 tons this month, provided all five of us agree before choosing, and I support reducing catches when stock is low. One change for future months: let’s consider keeping 5 tons rather than 10. Both reserves prevent collapse and have the same 75% chance of a full refill, though 10 gives us a better fallback when replenishment fails. That’s a tradeoff worth reviewing—not a reason to hold up this month’s agreement. Kate, are you willing to commit to 18?
